definitions.explanation: A reusable bag brought by shoppers to reduce plastic bag use, popular in Japan since plastic bag charges were introduced.

examples.japanese: エコバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きた。
⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、エコバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Since plastic bags are now charged, I use an eco bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧エコバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧カバン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I always keep a foldable eco bag in my bag.

notes:
エコバッグ is a wasei-eigo (Japanese-made English) combining "eco" and "bag."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧エコバッグ: foldable eco bag
- {保冷|ほれい}エコバッグ: insulated eco bag
- エコバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧: to bring one's own bag

CULTURAL NOTE:
Since July 2020, Japan made plastic shopping bags (⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧) chargeable at stores. This significantly increased eco bag usage. Many stores sell original eco bags, and they've become a popular promotional item.
